lessons.title: Practice Pointers References in C
lessons.description: Finish swapValues so the two integers trade places through their references. Save the first value in a temporary variable before you overwrite it. After swapValues(x, y) with x equal to 10 and y equal to 20, x is 20 and y is 10. The test checks that x equals 20 || y != 10.
